text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (September 9, 2024) for 1969 Eglinton Avenue West.

The Property Standards Committee - Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Deferred the appeal of the Property Standards Order (September 9, 2024) for 1969 Eglinton Avenue West, Folder Number 24 210253 PRS 00 IV to its meeting on March 17, 2025, as the appellant did not attend the hearing on February 24, 2025; if the appellant or a representative does not appear on March 17, 2025 the appeal hearing will proceed in their absence.
